name: Ibaraki Mariya
source:
A virgin mom with huge breasts and a heart of gold.
However, she’s hopelessly inefficient and clumsy, and Eri and Etsuko make fun of her.
She’s surprisingly sheltered for her age and rather shy.
Your clumsy, scatterbrained mom is made fun of by your big sister and the maid.
You resolve, “I have to protect Mom!”—but instead, she smothers you with her big boobs and pampers you.

[Translated fom [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ006438.html]DLsite[/url]]
